p1: Jules Navarro is a 52-year-old park ranger based in Flagstaff, Arizona, who loves astrophotography, trail maintenance, and cooking New Mexican food.
p10: Priya Nair is a 38-year-old conservator at a regional film archive in Kochi, India, living with her spouse and young daughter, and she spends her free time practicing Kathak, fermenting dosa batter, and caring for balcony orchids.
p11: Marceline Boucher is a 24-year-old apprentice luthier in Québec City, Canada, living in a shared apartment and spending her free time on contra dancing, sketching Art Nouveau posters, and winter birdwatching.
p12: Rina Matveeva is a 29-year-old courtroom stenographer in Almaty, Kazakhstan, living with her younger brother while training in aerial silks and spending weekends on urban beekeeping, Soviet mosaic photography, and experimenting with Georgian recipes.
p13: Farah Ben Youssef is a 43-year-old museum exhibition lighting designer living in Tunis, Tunisia, divorced and sharing custody of her son, with hobbies that include kite-making, oud listening sessions, and preserving citrus marmalade.
p14: Sanne de Vries is a 36-year-old court-certified sign language interpreter living in Groningen, the Netherlands, who recently changed employers and spends her free time sea-glass sorting, historical map browsing, and practicing baroque recorder.
p15: Noura El Fassi is a 47-year-old perfumer at a small fragrance house in Fez, Morocco, recently relocated from Rabat, with a deep interest in Andalusi music, geometric zellij pattern sketching, and weekend herbal distillation.
p2: Mina Cho is a 27-year-old marine insurance underwriter living in Busan, South Korea, who spends her free time bouldering, making espresso drinks, and learning conversational Japanese.
p3: Aarav Bhandari is a 34-year-old high school history teacher in Leeds, England, newly engaged, who is into canal kayaking, sourdough baking, and tabletop miniature painting.
p4: Lucía Ferreira is a 68-year-old retired municipal librarian living in Porto, Portugal, who volunteers at a community archive and enjoys fado records, balcony gardening, and restoring old fountain pens.
p5: Nadia al-Hadid is a 41-year-old neonatal ICU nurse living in Amman, Jordan, who recently shifted from long night shifts to a daytime role and spends her free time on Arabic calligraphy, road cycling, and caring for two rescue cats.
p6: Sofía Quispe is a 19-year-old first-year geology student in Arequipa, Peru, who works part-time at a campus museum shop and is obsessed with volcano hikes, charango practice, and collecting mineral specimens.
p7: Tomasz Zieliński is a 45-year-old tram operations dispatcher in Gdańsk, Poland, recently divorced and living with his teenage son, and he spends his free time on sea-kayaking, home pickling, and rebuilding vintage shortwave radios.
p8: Imani Okeke is a 31-year-old wedding cake decorator in Halifax, Nova Scotia, who recently relocated from Winnipeg and spends her off-hours cold-water swimming, doing linocut printmaking, and browsing local flea markets.
p9: Elias Rönn is a 58-year-old municipal wastewater process engineer in Umeå, Sweden, recently remarried, who spends his free time ice fishing, building scale ship models, and foraging for mushrooms.
